frozen.text: The cold got into your hands first, then your thinking. You sat down by the dead heater to rest for a minute.

breakdown.text: You stopped trusting the meters, then the walls, then the sound of your own breathing. When the knocking came again you were already at the door.

exposure.text: Somewhere past the third post you let go of the rope to rub your hands warm. When you reached for it again it wasn't there. The snow was soft, and you were so tired.
